capabilities: Write and highlight ink on notes
extras: Free, with an optional coffee donation. Ink is stored as JSON sidecars in a hidden .handwriting/ vault folder, so notes stay unchanged except for one handwriting-page-id frontmatter line. Includes an opt-in bug-report tool with offline copy/save options. Does not work well on iPhone.
motivation: The author wanted to recreate the feeling of writing and typing on the same page, as with OneNote on a Surface Pro, but inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian notes are text-only, so there is no built-in way to handwrite, draw, or annotate directly on a note or PDF.

relations.evidence: drawing structures and typing labels on the same OneNote page felt like literal magic
